outcome_summary: Added project-level document export support (`projectDocs`) to `ModuleJsonExportGenerator`. The implementation follows the established `moduleMetaData.exportDocs` pattern exactly: configuration is declared in the root `context.yaml` under `projectMetaData.exportDocs`, the generator reads and resolves the files at build time with the same containment guard used for module-level docs, and the JSON output always contains a `projectDocs` top-level key. All 15 tests pass and PHPStan reports no errors.
